# 🐉 agent-teams-pixel — a pixel cultivation hall for your AI team
> **Archived / no longer maintained.** Development continues in **dsh-pixel-team**. This repository
is kept for history; new issues and pull requests are not accepted.
**English (default)** · 简体中文
▲ 17-second tour — plan review · doctrine · task DAG · equipment · 15 realms · roster
> **One DSH session becomes a sect. A captain, a roster of specialists, a pixel hall you actually wa

nt to open.**
>
> Durable agents, dependency-aware tasks, quality gates, and a 15-realm cultivation
layer — local-first, MIT, no workflow engine required.
- 🏯 **A hall, not a dashboard** — six clickable wall facilities, a seven-button floor bar, and a liv

ing pixel scene for captain + members.
- 🧠 **Real team protocol** — durable subagents, automatic tas

k dispatch, mailbox, retries, cold recovery and independent review.
- ⚔️ **Specialist roles** — fron
tend, backend, integrator, verifier, reviewer, security; each has a bounded contract and evidence ru

les.
- 🌱 **Cultivation that means something** — every completed task and idle tick feeds a shared 15

-realm ladder; equipment, mounts and skills render in the hall.
- 📜 **封神榜 + 宗门志** — a sect roll, rea

lm ladder, support/community/about and feedback in one place.
- 🔒 **Local-first** — team state lives
in your workspace; no cloud account.
## 🎮 What's fun
Approve before spawn — 3 members, 3 tasks, 2 dependencies; nothing starts until you confirm. · Live
task DAG — the captain dispatches t1; 毒修 waits for t1, 体修 waits for t2.
Gear that shows up — equip 飞剑 and the captain actually rides it; artifacts, mounts and skills unlock
by realm, and the hall redraws instantly.
One sect, three cultivators — role, realm, model and reasoning effort at a glance. · 15 realms — fro
m 凡人 to 道祖. · History that stays — completed tasks and the next 开宗 entry.
All screenshots come from a live DSH session. If the hall sticks, a ⭐ helps it keep growing.

⭐ If the pixel hall makes your agents easier to run, a star helps a lot.
One command: dsh plugin --p
rofile desktop add agent-teams-pixel@0.3.0-rc.4
## ⚡ Quick start
**DeepSeek Harness (desktop / web)**
dsh plugin --profile desktop add agent-teams-pixel@0.3.0-rc.4
# reopen DSH → open 山门 · 名册
**From GitHub**

git clone https://github.com/EternalNight996/agent-teams-pixel
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./ag

://github.com/EternalNight996/agent-teams-pixel
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./agent-teams-pixel
**CLI / headless**
dsh --profile desktop
# ask: 用 AgentTeams 开一个团队做 …
Package version: **0.3.0-rc.4**. Recommended host: DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.3** (web + headless).
See compatibility.json for the exact matrix.
## 🏯 What you get
| Facility | What it does |

| **山门 · 名册** | current sect, roster history and team entries |
| **藏经阁 · 道统** | members, task contr

acts, staged plans, founding wizard |
| **功德碑 · 进度** | task dependencies, dispatch progress, verific

ation evidence |
| **封神榜** | sect roll, 15 realms, cultivation card, leveling tips, sect story |
| *

*天机阁** | equipment inventory: artifact / mount / skill, immediate hall preview |
| **宗门志** | support

, community, about and a privacy-bounded feedback form |
| **收件** | captain inbox, keyboard reachabl
e and text-escaped |
The wall and the floor bar are two routes into the same panels. Click a cultivator to open their con
versation; click their level badge to open gear.
## 🧩 One hall, every entry
| Entry | What you get |

| **Wall** | six facilities: roster, doctrine, progress, 封神榜, gear, 宗门志 |
| **Floor bar** | the same

panels plus settings, always one click away |
| **Cultivator** | their conversation; the level badg

e opens equipment |
| **CLI / headless** | the same tools and durable team state, no UI required |
|
**Local state** | workspace state under .agent-teams; no cloud account |
## 🐉 Why this exists
Most agent dashboards are lists. This one is a **place**: the captain’s desk, the gate, the merit st
ele, the ascension board. You can see who is working, who is idle, what is blocked, and what was del
ivered — without reading a log.
Under the pixels is a serious team runtime:

- captain-led task DAG with dependency-aware dispatch;
- persistent member sessions, mailbox and att

dent verifier/reviewer gates, repair rounds and cold recovery;
- per-role contracts that keep fronte
nd/backend/integrator work in disjoint layers.
## 🧩 Roles & templates
| Template | Default roles | Best for |
| **Full stack** | integrator · frontend · backend · verifier · reviewer | contract-first features;

parallel layers |
| **Security hardening** | auditor · security · verifier · reviewer | repro-before

-fix, minimal diff, residual risk |
| **Fix / feature / research / build / docs / debate** | small r

ole sets | everyday team work |
| **Architecture** | architect · implementer · verifier · reviewer |
boundaries and migrations |
Each specialist gets a fixed contract: ownership, must / must not, done, five-bullet report, and a w
orking budget. The full-stack team is intentionally five people: the integrator owns both the contra
ct and final integration, cutting one handoff.
## 🧾 Does it actually improve delivery?
| Signal | Evidence |

| Full suite | **pnpm verify** exit 0 |
| Browser-side contracts | **56/56** |
| Publish artifact |

package smoke checks runtime + support QRs, excludes source/tests/docs |
| Real team run | captain d
ispatch → member writes → independent review → summary; see docs/agent-teams-real-model-verification

.json |
| Isolation | reviewers cannot approve their own implementation |
This is a tool for **parallel wall-clock + independent verification**, not a promise that every task
gets cheaper. Small tasks are usually better with one agent.
